findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Upon arrival, the handwashing sink was observed obstructed with empty sani buckets and a spray bottle. The items were removed by the PIC. Be sure that handwashing sinks are always accessible to employees to ensure that hands are getting washed properly.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: There wasn't a sanitizer solution available at the start of the inspection. Discussed with PIC that a sanitizer solution must be available if food prep or serving is occurring. A sani solution was prepared and tested at 200ppm (quat) to correct the violation. Ensure that sanitizer solutions are always available to be sure that food contact surfaces are getting sanitized properly.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.
